acceptance: The forward-version contract is stated in the validator's tests and docs.
The next scheduled Release Canary run is green and issue #4106 is closed by it.
description:
Issue #4106 (opened 2026-11-11, run 43051915343 on develop 5bd2c19cc): tests/integration/test_submission_validation.py::test_validator_accepts_forward_numeric_schema_v2_family fails. The test writes a bundle from the 2.3-era fixture and sets version "2.99" to prove the validator accepts a forward numeric 2.x version. PR #4080 (d1e0891b83) added _validate_required_timing_fields in benchbox/validation/bundle.py, which applies required_timing_problems to every version where supports_timing_fields is true, so the forward-version fixture now fails on missing timing_method/platform timing fields. The test is in the credential-free non-fast tier, so PR CI did not run it.

Change. Decide the contract: a forward minor version must still carry every field required by the newest known version (update the fixture to a 2.4-complete bundle), or forward versions beyond KNOWN_SCHEMA_V2_VERSIONS are accepted with only the known-version checks. Fix the fixture or the validator accordingly, and confirm the next scheduled Release Canary is green so #4106 closes.

Guardrails: linked worktree; no explanatory comments; no CI skips.
